- `/foo#{bar}/`
- `%r[foo#{bar}]`

The bug is likely because the regex highlighting logic in the `components/prism-ruby.js` file does not handle interpolation correctly within the `/.../` syntax.

### Relevant Code from `components/prism-ruby.js`

```javascript
{
    'pattern': /(^|[^/])\\/(?!\\/)(?:\\[[^\\r\\n\\]]+\\]|\\\\.|[^[/\\\\\\r\\n])+\\/[gim]{0,3}(?=\\s*(?:$|[\\r\\n,.;})]))/,
    'lookbehind': true,
    'greedy': true
}
```

This code is supposed to match regex patterns in Ruby. The current pattern does not consider interpolation (`#{...}`) within regex delimiters `/.../`.

The fix involves modifying the regex pattern to include support for interpolation within `/.../` as follows:

```javascript
### components/prism-ruby.js

    'pattern': /(^|[^/])\\/(?!\\/)(?:\\[[^\\r\\n\\]]+\\]|\\\\.|[^[/\\\\\\r\\n])+\\/[gim]{0,3}(?=\\s*(?:$|[\\r\\n,.;})]))/,
```
